capabilities.text: Run in Azure, specifically in the UK South region
capabilities.quote: The tool will run in Azure, specifically in the UK South region to meet data residency requirements for NHS patient data.

capabilities.text: Use Azure App Services for the web frontend
capabilities.quote: I’ll use Azure App Services for the web frontend and Azure SQL Database with Transparent Data Encryption for the backend, both compliant with NHS Digital’s security standards.

capabilities.text: Use Azure SQL Database with Transparent Data Encryption for the backend
capabilities.quote: I’ll use Azure App Services for the web frontend and Azure SQL Database with Transparent Data Encryption for the backend, both compliant with NHS Digital’s security standards.

capabilities.text: Enforce authentication via Azure AD, requiring nurses to sign in with NHS credentials
capabilities.quote: Authentication will be enforced via Azure AD, requiring nurses to sign in with their existing NHS credentials.

capabilities.text: Retain all data for 7 years
capabilities.quote: All data will be retained for 7 years in accordance with NHS data retention policies.

capabilities.text: Integrate with the hospital’s electronic patient record (EPR) system using FHIR-based APIs
capabilities.quote: The tool must integrate with the hospital’s electronic patient record (EPR) system, which uses FHIR-based APIs hosted on a HL7 v2.5 gateway, and with the ward-level spreadsheet system, which is a SharePoint Online list synchronized via Power Automate.

capabilities.text: Read patient demographics and admission status via FHIR API
capabilities.quote: I’ll use the FHIR API to read patient demographics and admission status, and write ward notes using the FHIR Observation resource with a custom code system.

capabilities.text: Write ward notes using the FHIR Observation resource
capabilities.quote: I’ll use the FHIR API to read patient demographics and admission status, and write ward notes using the FHIR Observation resource with a custom code system.

capabilities.text: Update the ward-level spreadsheet system (SharePoint Online list) via a secure, scheduled sync job using Azure Logic Apps with OAuth 2.0 through Azure AD
capabilities.quote: The SharePoint list will be updated via a secure, scheduled sync job using Azure Logic Apps with OAuth 2.0 through Azure AD.

capabilities.text: Build the frontend using Blazor Server
capabilities.quote: Given this, I’ll design the frontend using Blazor Server to leverage their existing .NET skills and minimize learning curve, avoiding any dependency on external JavaScript libraries.

capabilities.text: Version one must be live by 15 October 2024
capabilities.quote: Version one must be live by 15 October 2024—this is aligned with the hospital group’s annual digital transformation milestone and the upcoming rollout of the new EPR system.

capabilities.text: MVP functionality: nurse login via Azure AD
capabilities.quote: This timeline requires a minimal viable product (MVP) with core functionality: nurse login via Azure AD, patient lookup via FHIR, ward note creation as a FHIR Observation resource, and sync to SharePoint via Power Automate.

capabilities.text: MVP functionality: patient lookup via FHIR
capabilities.quote: This timeline requires a minimal viable product (MVP) with core functionality: nurse login via Azure AD, patient lookup via FHIR, ward note creation as a FHIR Observation resource, and sync to SharePoint via Power Automate.

capabilities.text: MVP functionality: ward note creation as a FHIR Observation resource
capabilities.quote: This timeline requires a minimal viable product (MVP) with core functionality: nurse login via Azure AD, patient lookup via FHIR, ward note creation as a FHIR Observation resource, and sync to SharePoint via Power Automate.

capabilities.text: MVP functionality: sync to SharePoint via Power Automate
capabilities.quote: This timeline requires a minimal viable product (MVP) with core functionality: nurse login via Azure AD, patient lookup via FHIR, ward note creation as a FHIR Observation resource, and sync to SharePoint via Power Automate.

capabilities.text: Budget capped at £45,000 for MVP delivery
capabilities.quote: The budget is capped at £45,000 for the full MVP delivery, including development, testing, and deployment.

capabilities.text: Avoid third-party licensing costs
capabilities.quote: This allows us to build the core components in-house using existing Azure subscriptions and team capacity, but requires us to avoid third-party licensing costs.

capabilities.text: Approximately 85 nurses will use the tool at launch
capabilities.quote: At launch, approximately 85 nurses across three acute wards will use the tool—each ward has about 25–30 nurses, with around 30% expected to be active daily.

capabilities.text: Azure App Service will run on a Standard S1 tier with auto-scaling
capabilities.quote: This scale means the Azure App Service will run on a Standard S1 tier (1 core, 1.75 GB RAM) with auto-scaling enabled to handle peak load during shift changes.

capabilities.text: Comply with UK GDPR, NHS Digital Information Governance Code of Practice, and Health and Social Care Act 2008 Regulations
capabilities.quote: The system must comply with UK GDPR, the NHS Digital Information Governance Code of Practice, and the Health and Social Care Act 2008 (Regulated Activities) Regulations.

capabilities.text: Process all patient data under NHS Data Security and Protection Toolkit (DSPT) controls
capabilities.quote: All patient data will be processed under NHS Data Security and Protection Toolkit (DSPT) controls, with encryption at rest (Azure SQL TDE) and in transit (TLS 1.3).

capabilities.text: Retain access logs for 12 months
capabilities.quote: Access logs will be retained for 12 months, and all FHIR interactions will be audited via Azure Monitor with alerts on unauthorized access attempts.

capabilities.text: Audit all FHIR interactions via Azure Monitor with alerts on unauthorized access attempts
capabilities.quote: Access logs will be retained for 12 months, and all FHIR interactions will be audited via Azure Monitor with alerts on unauthorized access attempts.

capabilities.text: Undergo a DSPT self-assessment prior to go-live
capabilities.quote: The system will undergo a DSPT self-assessment prior to go-live.
